title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow autorollback workflow improvements
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Improvements to unified rollouts: enhanced autorollback decisioning for combined canary/A-B/shadow modes; added telemetry and e2e guards; no API breaking changes.
description: Summary: This PR makes a set of coordinated changes to the unified rollouts subsystem to improve safety and observability when running combined canary, A/B, and shadow deployments. Motivation: customers running mixed rollout strategies reported flakey auto-rollback decisions when signal sources (canary traffic metrics, AB experiment counters, and shadow telemetry) were noisy and not synchronized. This resulted in unnecessary rollbacks or delayed responses to regressions. This change implements a multi-signal quorum, improved metric alignment, configurable quarantine stage, and e2e stability guards to reduce false positives while preserving rapid rollback on real regressions. Design highlights: 1) Multi-metric quorum evaluator: a new evaluator that aggregates metrics from canary SLOs, AB objective deltas, and shadow-side quality regressions, and requires quorum across configurable groups before triggering automated rollback. 2) Metric alignment window: a sliding alignment window (default 30s) normalizes timestamp skew across telemetry sources and computes consistent evaluation windows to avoid mismatched sample ranges. 3) Quarantine probing stage: a new intermediate stage that puts candidate variants into a "quarantine" probe where weight is ramped slowly and additional probes (synthetic canaries and targeted workloads) run prior to full rollout or rollback. 4) Observability improvements: added per-rollout telemetry (rollout_id, stage, last_evaluator_result, quorum_breakdown) and tracing spans for evaluation decision path. 5) Safety guards and e2e checks: e2e tests and a preflight check that requires minimum sample counts before authorizing autorollback decisions. 6) Backwards-compatible config: rollout spec gains optional fields (quorum_config, alignment_window_ms, quarantine_stage) with safe defaults so existing rollouts behave unchanged. Checklist: - [x] Implement multi-metric quorum evaluator and unit tests - [x] Add metric alignment window and fuzz tests for skew - [x] Implement quarantine stage and integration tests - [x] Add telemetry metrics and tracing hooks - [x] Add e2e stability guard tests and preflight check - [x] Update docs and rollout examples - [x] Add canary/AB/shadow combined test harness in perf-canary lab Changes: commits summarized below; code touches rollout controller, evaluator engine, telemetry exporter, and rollout e2e tests. No public API schema changes other than optional rollout spec fields. Migration notes: rollout specs without new fields use existing evaluation logic. Operators can opt-in by specifying quorum_config and quarantine_stage. Testing: local unit and integration tests added; CI e2e suite exercised via perf-canary harness; manual smoke tests run on staging cluster with representative traffic profiles. Impact: expected significant reduction in false-positive rollbacks for mixed-strategy rollouts; slightly increased decision latency (default +100-300ms) due to alignment but negligible for most production SLOs. Related: Linear ENG-1245 (autorollback multi-signal quorum), ENG-1301 (quarantine probing stage).

merge_info: Merged by Priya Natarajan via squash merge. Merge commit message: 'unified-rollouts: canary+AB+shadow autorollback improvements (ENG-1245, ENG-1301)'
notes: This PR deliberately keeps defaults conservative. Operators with high sensitivity to latency should leave alignment_window_ms unset or set to a smaller value. Teams should opt-in to quorum_config and quarantine_stage in rollout specs. Observability dashboards updated (see docs/unified-rollouts.md) to show quorum_breakdown and last_evaluator_result for faster debugging.
changelog_summary: Enhanced automated rollback workflow: multi-signal quorum, alignment window, quarantine stage, improved telemetry and e2e stability guards.
e2e_test_results: Preflight e2e suite: 24/25 tests passed; one flaky test (synthetic heavy-traffic probe) under investigation but does not affect autorollback gating in default config.
maintainer_notes: Follow-up tasks: 1) create a canary for the new quorum evaluator internally and run 2 weeks of A/B tests; 2) add a rollout-migration-check to admin console to surface rollouts that could benefit from quarantine; 3) extend perf-canary profiles to cover more AB variants.
risk_assessment: Low-medium. Changes centralized to rollout controller and evaluator; safety guards and preflight tests mitigate accidental regressions. No breaking API changes. Operators should monitor rollout.telemetry.quorum_breakdown for at least 48h post-deploy.
